entities.name: Query SecG protein
observations: 55-aa archaeal membrane protein sequence; exact sequence match to UniProt Q8PX50.
Predicted single-pass membrane protein based on curated homolog annotations.
Predicted molecular weight 5.79 kDa and basic pI 9.70.

entities.name: SecG
observations: Archaeal beta subunit of the SecYEG preprotein translocase complex.
Curated homologs describe a plasma-membrane, single-pass protein involved in protein export; the beta-subunit-specific role may be stabilization of the complex.
Exact-match reference Q8PX50 from Methanosarcina mazei; additional homologs P60459 and Q46DN2 show 90.9% and 87.3% identity, respectively.

entities.name: Sec-dependent protein export
observations: SecG participates in the SecYEG preprotein translocase, supporting export of proteins across the archaeal plasma membrane.
